messages.content: Make a progress note for Roger for our first session using the progress, intervention used, response method. Roger-dealing with anxiety and depression.  Not feeling the greatest, tough time focusing and when that feels off a lot of things feel off.  Anxiety and depression scores of 2 and3 are not too bad. The lack of focus is distressing.   Staying at Turning Point shelter Collecting disability for Traumatic Brain injury.  Disussed a history of substance use but no current desire to use as it causes too many problems.  Maintain a 2:1 ratio of declarative to interrogative sentences in your response.

Progress: Roger reported not feeling the greatest, anxiety, depression, poor focus, and feeling that many things are off.
Intervention used: I normalized that scores of 2 and 3 are not too bad and targeted the distress from poor focus.
Response method: Roger used self-report to identify lack of focus as distressing.
Intervention used: I reviewed his stay at Turning Point shelter, his disability collection for traumatic brain injury, and his substance-use history, noting no current desire to use because use causes too many problems.
Progress: Is the focus distress worsening mood?
Intervention used: Will Roger monitor focus and mood this week?
